title: A MySQL trigger naming a dropped column fails writes
symptom: After ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, every INSERT and UPDATE on the table failed
cause: MySQL keeps the trigger body as text and resolves NEW.<column> at run time; the drop doesn't touch or check triggers
effect: An audit or sync trigger on the source blocks the application's writes after a schema change
fix: Recreate the table's triggers from the schema after a schema change (audit-triggers.py --only T --replace)
